data.title: 中野五月 · 雪见温泉中的红晕容颜
data.description: 银装素裹的深冬雪夜里，露天岩石温泉的水面上飘散着细碎的落雪。五月浸润在滚烫温润的清泉中，温热的水汽让她的脸颊与雪白肌肤染上娇艳欲滴的绯红。她双手微捧起泉水，赤红的长发挽在侧颈，在漫天落雪中展现出惊心动魄的古典艳丽。
data.action: soaking in rock onsen, snowflakes falling on hair, radiant flushed cheeks
data.lighting: soft wooden lanterns glowing amid falling snow
data.promptProse: Soaking in a steaming outdoor rock onsen surrounded by deep winter snow, Nakano Itsuki tilts her head as gentle snowflakes melt upon her bare shoulders. A white bath towel is wrapped around her body. The rising steam wraps around her long red hair, highlighting her vividly flushed, captivating cheeks.
data.animaCaption: Itsuki soaking peacefully in a snowy outdoor onsen at night.
